# Selección de registros sísmicos {#sec-srs}

{{< include /_chapters/srs.model.es.md >}}

## Registros Seleccionados {#sec-srs_results}

### Conjunto seleccionado {#sec-srs_results_records}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_tbl/SRS.ES.qmd",
      stem = "srs-records",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      heading = SelectionTable$label[[i]],
      level = 4L,
      anchor = "sec-srs_records",
      context = "capítulo SRS"
    )
  }
  rm(i)
}
```

### Compatibilidad con el espectro objetivo {#sec-srs_results_psa}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_fig/srs.psa.ES.qmd",
      stem = "srs-psa",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      heading = SelectionTable$label[[i]],
      level = 4L,
      anchor = "sec-srs_psa",
      context = "capítulo SRS"
    )
  }
  rm(i)
}
rm(list = intersect(c("SiteTable", "SelectionTable"), ls()))
```
